posts.text: AlphaSense is betting a big part of making these systems cost effective will be a new layer of AI-enabled, precomputed analysis. Much of what goes into an earnings preview is fairly standardized across analysts—even if each analyst’s process and approach are unique. That makes it a natural candidate for precompute. This drops cost and latency multiple orders of magnitude while enabling even higher quality analysis. [Fable] (within SuperAnalyst) can spend more time reasoning, less time recreating the wheel
